details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers K1 (Group and Company revenue and net profit), K2 (LNG terminal revenue growth), K3 (LET revenue decrease), K5 (operating cash flows), K6 (cash and cash equivalents), and K7 (total borrowings). However, it omits core material meaning for K4 (comLNG segment revenue growth and supporting activities), K8 (change to unitary Board governance model), and K9 (Group EBITDA increase). These omissions affect the overall completeness assessment, placing the coverage in the Neutral/Mixed category.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary demonstrates strong internal logical coherence. All statements build upon each other without contradiction: revenue growth drivers are clearly identified (S3), profitability metrics consistently show improvement (S5-S7, S10-S11), cost explanations are provided (S8-S9), cash flow movements are logically explained (S15-S16), and balance sheet changes align with reported profits (S19-S21). The summary maintains clear organizational flow from revenue through to cash flow and balance sheet impacts. No material repetitions or logical gaps are present. While segment figures don't sum to total revenue (a common accounting practice), the candidate never claims they should, so this doesn't constitute an internal contradiction.
